dct_creator_sm: Sarah A Finkelstein (University of Toronto, Department of Earth Sciences, University of Toronto).
dct_description_sm:
The CBC3-01 sediment core was collected from a riverine-influenced freshwater marsh in Norfolk County of southern Ontario, Canada on 5 October 2019.
Surface vegetation at site was dominated by Reed Canary Grass; there was no standing water at time of sampling.
CBC3-01 (4.29 m in total length) was collected using a Russian peat corer, and was subsampled into 2-cm increments which were stored in plastic ziploc bags at 6°C between collection and sample preparation.

This dataset accompanies the paper "Past vegetation and hydrological change since the Middle Holocene in a Lake Erie riparian marsh provide a guide for ecosystem restoration" accepted at the journal Quaternary Research in August 2025.
dct_title_s: Past vegetation and hydrological change since the Middle Holocene in a Lake Erie riparian marsh provide a guide for ecosystem restoration
